How is the payout quoted?

Profit on a winning trade, excluding your stake.

A losing trade loses the full stake. Fixed payout; fees and refunds excluded.

What if you win half?

Hypothetical 100 trades: 50 wins, 50 losses, same stake and payout.

−$100.00net result, before fees

50 × $8.00 − 50 × $10.00 = −$100.00

The payout changes the maths.

A winning trade can pay less than a losing trade costs. That is why a 50% win rate can still lose money. The calculator shows the arithmetic; it does not estimate your chance of winning.
